_comment: 口パク 6枚（VisemeFace）。設定画だけを 参照に 渡す。プロンプトは build_mouth_ledgers.ts が buildMouthPrompt() から 作る（手で 直さない）。生の 6枚は composite_mouth.mjs で 閉じた 口の 絵に 口だけ 重ねてから 置く。

scenes.title: nyam の 口パク（closed）
scenes.scene:
A bust-up portrait for a talking-head animation frame.

Character: 先輩の ベテラン エンジニア（ベトナム出身。支払い・通知など しくみの 中を 見る 人。学習者より 先に 日本の 現場に 入った 人） — Vietnamese man in his twenties — draw the face closely after the reference photo, and clearly Southeast Asian rather than Japanese, so the cast reads as international. Warm light-brown skin, a shade or two deeper than the Japanese characters beside him. Wide face with high broad cheekbones, a full squarish jaw and a rounded chin — NOT a narrow pointed anime chin. Broad nose with a low flat bridge, a rounded wide tip and visible nostril wings. Almond eyes set a little wide apart, low single-fold eyelids, outer corners angled gently down. Thick straight black eyebrows. Full lips and a wide easy smile showing the upper teeth. Short black hair, tapered close at the sides and left longer on top so it sweeps up and back off a clear forehead, no fringe. Wears a coral (#F2654A) knit cardigan over a plain cream button-down shirt with the collar open, dark navy ankle-length trousers, and beige low-top sneakers. Carries a small A6 white notebook and a blue ballpoint pen. Height about 170cm, slim build, relaxed upright posture.

Framing: head and shoulders, facing the camera straight on, centered,
eyes looking at the camera, neutral friendly expression.
Background: a single flat muted blue-grey color (#b8c9db), like a plain office wall.
No gradient, no pattern, no props.

Mouth: mouth closed, relaxed gentle smile.
Everything else (background color, hair, eyes, eyebrows, head angle, clothing, framing, lighting)
must be EXACTLY the same as the reference image. Change ONLY the mouth.

Style: clean modern Japanese manga / anime style, soft cel shading, bright friendly palette, rounded shapes, no harsh shadows, office and school settings, contemporary Japan.
Avoid: no text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image, speech balloons must be completely EMPTY (white inside, no writing), no watermark, no signature, no logo, no frame border, no six fingers, no extra limbs, no costume changes between panels, no duplicate faces of the same character in one panel.
